#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int W, M;
    cin >> W >> M;

    vector<int> B(101, 0);
    int tmp = M;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
        B[i] = tmp % W;
        tmp /= W;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
        if (B[i] > 1) {
            B[i] -= W;
            B[i + 1]++;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i <= 100; ++i) {
        if (B[i] < -1 || B[i] > 1) {
            cout << "NO\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout << "YES\n";
    return 0;
}
